area: Testbed audit: reflective coverage of the aggregate report

find.report_claim: cycle 204's testbed_report hardcoded eight families and its test asserted the same hardcoded list, so two older no-arg reports were silently omitted
find.live_evidence: introspection of ShooterGame found nine no-arg *_report/*_probe methods (excluding testbed_report itself); only six were named by the aggregate: profile_store_probe and presentation_rng_report were missing
find.consumer_evidence: after the fix the aggregate has ten families plus a sources list naming all eight composed no-arg reports, and a reflective test fails if a future one is not wired in

killed: extending the hardcoded family list again: that is exactly the blind spot that let the two reports through
removing the parameterized reports (enemy_blend_report etc.) from the composition: they are still present via explicit family calls and only the sources list tracks no-arg methods
caching the reflective discovery: it must see additions at test time
analyze.survivor: add storage/presentation families, publish a self-describing sources list, and introspect ShooterGame in the test

fix.shooter: shooter/game.py adds profile_store_probe and presentation_rng_report to testbed_report plus a sorted sources list; tests/test_testbed_report_mechanics.py gains the reflective coverage test (now 5 tests); README documents the two new families and the guard

shooter.failing_first: the new reflective test failed with KeyError: 'sources' while the four hardcoded tests passed — direct evidence of the blind spot
shooter.own_test_bugs: two first-draft assertions were wrong: sources is a list, not a report dict, and some families are containers without their own schema; both were corrected
shooter.measured: sources = arena_tile_report, asset_digest_report, enemy_steering_report, engine_version_report, keystone_contract_report, nav_plan_report, presentation_rng_report, profile_store_probe; ~8787 JSON bytes
shooter.mutation: dropping profile_store_probe from sources fails the reflective test; game.py restored byte-identically (sha256 8fb027cf7ab0463476ac850da540ed5f4618e4c7411085e50169138af3e1d947)
shooter.readme_budget: README is 35,661 of 37,500 chars (1,839 left); the guidelines gate passes but future cycles should monitor this limit
